claims.assertion: Mari Swa says Taygetan investigators linked a pathogen allegedly used against Queen Alenym to a laboratory aboard a Saturn-orbiting Federation biosphere ship.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: The source presents an allegation and says evidence was submitted to local councils.

claims.assertion: Mari reports that the Toleka flagship would leave Earth orbit for repairs and that she would move her headquarters to Sadicleya.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She attributes the move to Toleka’s age and recurring system problems.

review_flags: The video advances unverified claims about an assassination attempt, extraterrestrial actors, and alleged pathogen development.
coverage_gaps: Other sections discuss alleged timeline intervention and technical problems aboard the Toleka.
